reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset & Brown treat the chains as Satan's final doom, already decreed but only gradually carried out, leaving him free to roam until then.

sides.snippet: Your adversary the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour
sides.verseText: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.

sides.snippet: cast them down to Tartarus, and committed them to pits of darkness, to be reserved to judgment
sides.verseText: For if God didn't spare angels when they sinned, but cast them down to Tartarus, and committed them to pits of darkness, to be reserved to judgment;
